SELECT c.conversation_id , c.status , m.label AS menu_label , c.user_id , c.assigned_admin_id , c.last_message_at , c.created_at , (SELECT msg.content FROM chat_message msg WHERE msg.conversation_id = c.conversation_id ORDER BY msg.message_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_message_content , (SELECT msg.sender_type FROM chat_message msg WHERE msg.conversation_id = c.conversation_id ORDER BY msg.message_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_message_sender_type FROM chat_conversation c LEFT JOIN chat_menu m ON m.menu_id = c.menu_id WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY (c.status = 'WAITING_AGENT') DESC, c.last_message_at ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_conversation c WHERE 1 = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_conversation WHERE status = 'WAITING_AGENT'

SELECT m.label AS menu_label , COUNT(c.conversation_id) AS conversation_count , COALESCE(clicks.click_count, 0) AS click_count
, COALESCE(SUM(c.status = 'WAITING_AGENT'), 0) AS waiting_count , COALESCE(SUM(c.ai_answer_count > 0), 0) AS ai_answered_count , AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, c.created_at, first_agent.replied_at)) AS avg_first_response_seconds FROM chat_menu m LEFT JOIN chat_conversation c ON c.menu_id = m.menu_id AND c.created_at >= #{since} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT menu_id, COUNT(*) AS click_count FROM chat_menu_click WHERE clicked_at >= #{since} GROUP BY menu_id ) clicks ON clicks.menu_id = m.menu_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT conversation_id, MIN(created_at) AS replied_at FROM chat_message WHERE sender_type = 'AGENT' GROUP BY conversation_id ) first_agent ON first_agent.conversation_id = c.conversation_id GROUP BY m.menu_id, m.label, clicks.click_count ORDER BY (COALESCE(clicks.click_count, 0) + COUNT(c.conversation_id)) DESC, m.display_order
SELECT m.label FROM chat_conversation c JOIN chat_menu m ON m.menu_id = c.menu_id WHERE c.conversation_id = #{conversationId}
